scheme_name: Payment of Ex-Gratia to the Families of Suicidal Weavers
other_conditions: Family of a weaver who committed suicide due to weaving‑related economic distress such as indebtedness, lack of employment, harassment by fellow villagers, or inability to provide livelihood to family members.
The suicide must have occurred on or after 1 April 1997.
The family should not have received any prior relief or family assistance.
benefits_summary: Provides an ex‑gratia payment of ₹1,00,000 (plus a loan settlement up to ₹50,000) along with rehabilitation support such as school admission, housing, and counseling.
